user.title: Add a recuperator
user.description: Pick the two fans and the two temperature probes. The inside probe sits at the basement end of the core, the outside probe at the outdoor end. Breathing starts switched off; turn on the Breathing switch when ready.

settings.title: Recuperator settings
settings.description: All settings take effect within a second, without restarting the cycle. They are also available as entities on the device page.

data_description.recovery_percent: End a phase once the far probe has closed this much of the gap. Low (10-25%): switch as soon as the far end of the core starts to change, best heat recovery, shorter phases. High (80%+): let the core fill up, longer phases, more heat lost at the end of each phase.
data_description.settle_seconds: The far probe counts as settled if it moved less than the settle change over this many seconds.
data_description.settle_delta: How little the far probe may move during the settle window to count as settled (ended early because the core has done all it will).
data_description.min_phase_seconds: No exhaust or intake phase ends before this, whatever the probes say.
data_description.max_phase_seconds: No exhaust or powered intake phase runs longer than this (up to 24 hours).
data_description.pause_seconds: Both fans off for this long between phases, so a fan stops before the other starts.
data_description.timed_exhaust_seconds: Length of each exhaust phase in Timed mode, and whenever the probes cannot be used (inside and outside too similar, or a probe unavailable).
data_description.timed_intake_seconds: Length of each intake phase in Timed mode, and whenever the probes cannot be used. The cold intake limit still applies; a passive intake uses Passive intake maximum instead.
data_description.similar_band: If the two probes differ by less than this when a phase starts, that phase is timed instead, using Timed exhaust or Timed intake (nothing to recover, e.g. mild weather or hose disconnected).
data_description.cold_threshold: At or below this outdoor temperature, the cold-weather limits apply.
data_description.cold_intake_max_seconds: In cold weather, intake never runs longer than this. Allow enough time for fresh air to get through the ducting (several minutes with long hoses or slow fans); Maximum supply drop protects the room.
data_description.cold_exhaust_extra_seconds: In cold weather, exhaust runs at least as long as the last intake and at most this much longer.
data_description.reset_to_defaults: Ignore the values above and restore these settings to their defaults. The diagram colours and replay settings are kept.
data_description.min_supply_temperature: Optional hard floor: the intake also ends if the air entering the room drops below this temperature. -30 (the default) means off. Only set it if there is a temperature the room must never see, e.g. near water pipes.
data_description.max_supply_drop: During intake the inside probe reads the air entering the room. Once the minimum phase has passed, the intake ends if that air is more than this much colder than the room (the basement temperature from the last exhaust). Works in any season: it follows the room, so a cold room still breathes.
data_description.passive_intake: Intake phases run with the intake fan off: after each exhaust, the room refills on its own through the core, for up to the passive intake maximum. The exhaust fan works as usual. Passive inflow shows whether air really came in.
data_description.passive_intake_max_seconds: With passive intake on, the longest an intake phase may last (it can end sooner by the usual rules: recovery target, settled, supply drop, cold limits).
data_description.passive_flow_delta: During a passive intake, the inside probe moving this much towards the outdoor temperature counts as air flowing in.

colours.title: Diagram colours
colours.description: Each stop is a temperature and the colour shown at that temperature; colours in between are blended. Pick a colour with the colour box, clear a temperature to remove its stop, or fill in an empty row to add one. The order does not matter: stops are sorted by temperature. At least two stops are needed.

data_description.reset_colours: Ignore the rows above and restore the weather-service colour scale.

link.title: Linked unit
link.description: A second unit that breathes together with this one, moving air the opposite way so the house stays balanced: while this recuperator exhausts, the linked unit takes air in, and while this one takes air in, the linked unit exhausts. It follows this recuperator's phases, pauses and mode. Saving restarts the recuperator.

data_description.link_type: Full recuperator: a second biphasic unit with its own exhaust and intake fans. Intake fan only: runs while this recuperator exhausts. Exhaust fan only: runs while this recuperator takes air in.
data_description.link_exhaust_switch: Needed for a full recuperator or an exhaust fan. Ignored for an intake fan only.
data_description.link_intake_switch: Needed for a full recuperator or an intake fan. Ignored for an exhaust fan only.

replay.title: Replay
replay.description: Used by the Create button on the Replay device. Running the Create replay action with values saves them here too.

data_description.replay_hours: How much history the Create replay button replays. Also saved from the last Create replay action.
data_description.replay_playback_seconds: How long one loop of the replay lasts.
data_description.replay_frames: Number of frames (0 = one per minute of history, 60 to 1440).

error.colour_missing: Pick a colour for this stop, or clear its temperature.
error.too_few_stops: At least two stops are needed.
error.duplicate_temperature: Two stops have the same temperature.
error.link_fan_missing: This kind of linked unit needs this fan.
error.link_fan_is_own: This is one of this recuperator's own fans; pick the linked unit's fan.
error.fan_in_use: This fan is already driven by another recuperator.
error.same_switch: The linked exhaust and intake fans must be different switches.

create_replay.name: Create replay
create_replay.description: Builds an animated diagram from recorded history, so you can watch the recuperator breathe. The result appears in the Diagram replay image and is saved under /local/recuperator/. Values you give are remembered and used by the Create replay button; values left out use the saved ones.

config_entry_id.name: Recuperator
config_entry_id.description: Which recuperator (optional if there is only one).

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How much history to replay, ending at End (or now). Left out: the saved value (default 24).

end.name: End
end.description: When the replay ends (optional, default now).

playback_seconds.name: Playback length
playback_seconds.description: How long one loop of the animation lasts. Left out: the saved value (default 60).

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: Number of frames (0 = one per minute of history, 60 to 1440). Left out: the saved value.
